Legal

Privacy policy

Last updated: November 2026

Who we are

Coastline Digital is a US-based software engineering and AI consulting company located in San Diego, California. We provide custom software engineering, AI and machine learning, cloud and data engineering, enterprise modernization, dedicated engineering teams, and engineering delivery partnerships.

Contact: hello@coastlinedigital.net

Information we collect

When you use our project inquiry or partnership inquiry forms, we collect the information you choose to provide, which may include:

  • Your name and work email address
  • Your company or firm name, your role, and your company website
  • The type of inquiry, services or capabilities of interest, and partnership model
  • Your project description or message
  • Optional timeline and budget range

If you email us directly, we receive the information included in your email. Job applicants who email a proposal share the information included in that email.

We do not currently use analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies on this website. If we add analytics in the future, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where required before any analytics load.

How we use your information

We use the information you provide to:

  • Respond to your inquiry
  • Discuss your project, partnership, or application
  • Provide the services you request

We do not sell your information to third parties.

Form submission

Our forms are processed by FormSubmit, a third-party form handling service. When you submit a form, your information is transmitted to FormSubmit, which may ask you to complete a verification step, and is then forwarded to us by email. FormSubmit has its own privacy policy governing how it handles data.

Website fonts and third-party requests

The typefaces on this website are hosted on our own domain, so loading a page does not send requests to font providers. Apart from form submission, described above, pages do not load content from third parties.

Data retention

We retain your contact information for as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry and provide services. If you would like us to delete your information, contact us at hello@coastlinedigital.net.

Your rights

You may:

  • Request access to the information we have about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your information

To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@coastlinedigital.net.

Changes to this policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with a new “last updated” date.

Contact

If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at hello@coastlinedigital.net.
